pass.description: true when every entry of `candidates` is a "use", false when any is a "leak".

reasoning.description: The checklist the rubric asks for, and for each leak what it asks you to name. On a fail it is shown to the agent that wrote the code.

candidates.description: Your classification of every match in the module's matches file, one entry per match and none for anything else.

path.description: The match's path, as its line in the matches file gives it.

line.description: The match's line number, as its line in the matches file gives it.

verdict.description: "leak": the module's logic outside its home. "use": a use of the module.
